name: Glow Rescue
rationale: Names the character-tile transformation (sleepy to starry-eyed = "glow up") and the game's own rescue-board framing in one plain, sayable phrase; zero conflict signal on Play, App Store, or the general web.

name: Drowsy Drift
rationale: "Drowsy" is the character art's starting state; "Drift" is literally the Threes!-style sliding-tile motion. Describes both the cast and the mechanic with zero conflict anywhere.

name: Cuddle Cove
rationale: Warm and huddled-together in tone without colliding with the existing "Huddle" games brand; "Cove" anchors it to the game's harbor-and-chapter world map.

name: Twinkle Cove
rationale: "Twinkle" mirrors the starry-eyed evolved tile art; "Cove" keeps the place/journey framing. No close match anywhere.

name: Snug Convoy
rationale: Warmth ("snug") paired with the sense of a caravan of rescued little characters traveling together across the six chapters (Harbor, Foundry, Orchard, Bazaar, Glacier, Observatory).

name: Bundle Rescue
rationale: Plain-spoken; names the mechanic (merge = bundle tiles together) and the in-game framing (rescue) directly, with zero conflict anywhere.

name: Lantern Cove
rationale: "Lantern" evokes the warm glow motif of the character tiles; "Cove" keeps the place/journey framing. Backup pick.

name: Ember Convoy
rationale: "Ember" (campfire warmth) plus "Convoy" (traveling caravan) evokes cozy travel across the six biomes. Backup pick.
